item.text:
**3B.7**

Verdict: mixed on paper, weak in practice. I found several 2024 programs aimed at women, children, and ethnic-minority communities, but the larger record still shows pervasive abuse, trafficking risk, religious harassment, and no evidence of comprehensive protection against targeted violence or displacement.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| **Launch of the National Action Month on Gender Equality and Gender-Based Violence Prevention & Response to 2024** | United Nations in Viet Nam | 2024-11-15 | https://vietnam.un.org/en/283933-launch-national-action-month-gender-equality-and-gender-based-violence-prevention-response | MOLISA, the Ministry of Public Security, and UN Women launched a national campaign under the theme of ensuring social welfare and eliminating violence against women and girls. This is the clearest 2024 pro-protection action I found for women and girls. | `3B.7` |
| **Project 8 of the National Target Program on Gender Equality in Ethnic Minority and Mountainous Regions: Obstacles and shortcomings need to be removed for effective implementation** | Vietnam.vn | 2024-09-29 | https://www.vietnam.vn/en/du-an-8-chuong-trinh-mtqg-voi-binh-dang-gioi-o-vung-dtts-va-mien-nui-can-thao-go-vuong-mac-bat-cap-de-trien-khai-hieu-qua-bai-cuoi | The Women’s Union said it coordinated a government-backed program with ministries, implementation plans, and remedies for problems affecting women and children in ethnic-minority and mountainous regions. This supports targeted anti-neglect policy, though it is programmatic rather than crisis-response evidence. | `3B.7` |
| **Agencies urged fix shortcomings in child care, protection this year** | Vietnam News | 2024-01-12 | https://vietnamnews.vn/society/1639130/agencies-urged-fix-shortcomings-in-child-care-protection-this-year.html | The Deputy PM told agencies to urgently implement child-care and protection programs and address child abuse, school violence, cyberspace safety, counseling, and stimulant use. This is positive evidence of protection efforts for children. | `3B.7` |
| **Vietnam: A Gloomy Year for Human Rights** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-01-11 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/vietnam-gloomy-year-human-rights | HRW said women, girls, children, and religious minorities faced pervasive abuse, while activists and environmentalists were unjustly imprisoned. This is strong counterevidence that vulnerable groups were not reliably protected. | `3B.7`, `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.4`, `3B.5` |
| **Vietnam: Pledges to Improve Human Rights Remain Empty Promises** | Human Rights Watch | 2024-09-27 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/27/vietnam-pledges-improve-human-rights-remain-empty-promises | HRW said Vietnam rejected independent human-rights oversight and still subjected unrecognized religious groups to surveillance, harassment, forced renunciation, arrest, and lengthy imprisonment. This is direct evidence against serious protection of vulnerable groups. | `3B.7`, `3B.1`, `3B.2`, `3B.4`, `3B.5` |
| **2024 Trafficking in Persons Report: Vietnam** | U.S. Department of State | 2024 report, published 2025 | https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2111791.html | The report says women, children, rural residents, and ethnic minorities were especially vulnerable to trafficking and exploitation, with children and minority communities at elevated risk. This suggests persistent failure to protect vulnerable groups from systematic abuse. | `3B.7`, `3B.2`, `3B.4`, `3B.5` |

Search gap: I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Trọng personally led an effective, sustained protection effort against targeted violence or displacement affecting minorities, women, or children. The positive evidence is mostly broad social-policy programming; the negative evidence is stronger and more specific.
